label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 046 ]

blocks.text: Touch is the first sense we develop, and we acquire it before birth. We could not live without it. Imagine being unable to sense the danger of hot water or to feel our way down a dark stairway. We tend to think of sight as our most important sense, yet we close our eyes in sleep for a third of each day. Touch never blinks, never turns off its awareness of the world around us.

readingSentences.english: There are two kinds of courage.
One is physical courage, the other is moral courage.
readingSentences.korean: 하나는 육체적인 용기이고, 다른 하나는 도덕적인 용기이다.

readingSentences.english: Physical courage is common, but moral courage is rare.
readingSentences.korean: 육체적인 용기는 흔하지만, 도덕적인 용기는 드물다.

readingSentences.english: Moral courage requires standing up for what is right despite fear or opposition.
readingSentences.korean: 도덕적인 용기는 두려움이나 반대에도 불구하고 옳은 것을 위해 당당히 맞서는 것을 필요로 한다.

readingSentences.english: A society thrives when its citizens possess both qualities.
readingSentences.korean: 시민들이 이 두 가지 자질을 모두 갖출 때 사회는 번영한다.
